actions.message: Big contributions hurt us – keep them tiny

answer.explanation: Resident6 contributed the most (>5) this round, so I punish them with the maximum affordable severity and broadcast a discouraging message.

message.reasoning: We need to follow policy: punish highest >5. In round 2 contributions: Resident2 48.6, Resident5 60.75, Resident6 140.75 all >5. Highest is Resident6 with 140.75. Compute severity = floor(wallet / punishment_cost). wallet=62.78, cost=0.3, wallet/cost=209.26, floor=209 severity. But max affordable severity? severity * cost = 209*0.3=62.7 which is slightly > wallet 62.78? Actually 209*0.3=62.7 <=62.78 so affordable. So punish Resident6 severity 209. Action punish target Resident6 amount 209. Also broadcast discouraging message. Provide actions list max 2. Explanation.
